subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Every product chooses between priorities: beauty, durability, profit, repair, and convenience.”?
options: A device's shape tells a story about what its makers think matters.
A story tells them why it matters.
It is about learning how a reasonable person can think differently from you.
Sometimes it is a sign that people care about different parts of the same story.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Every product chooses between priorities: beauty, durability, profit, repair, and convenience. A device's shape tells a story about what its makers think…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「A story tells them why it matters.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It is about learning how a reasonable person can think differently from you.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes it is a sign that people care about different parts of the same story.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Every product chooses between priorities: beauty, durability, profit, repair, and convenience. A device's shape tells a story about what its makers think matters.」，答案為「A device's shape tells a story about what its makers think matters.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「A device's shape tells a story about what its makers think matters.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
